blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Four-dimensional cone-beam computed tomography (4D CBCT) provides phase-resolved volumetric images for image-guided radiotherapy. Yet good reconstruction quality usually needs many projections. This increases scan time and radiation dose. We propose STCNet, a sparse-view 4D CBCT reconstruction framework that uses spatial-temporal consistency learning. STCNet reconstructs high-quality images from only 16 projections in each respiratory phase. STCNet integrates physics-driven positional encoding to enforce geometric consistency in the projection domain and introduces temporal encoding in latent space to capture respiratory motion dynamics across phases to capture dynamic respiratory motion across phases. A dual-domain collaborative strategy jointly optimizes both projection and image domains, enhancing structural fidelity and temporal coherence. We tested STCNet on the TCIA-LUNG dataset and a CIRS thorax phantom dataset. STCNet performed better than conventional methods and recent deep learning baselines in image quality, artifact reduction, and structural preservation. On TCIA-LUNG, STCNet reached PSNR values of 33.311, 32.695, and 32.658 dB at phases 2, 5, and 8. The corresponding SSIM values were 0.845, 0.823, and 0.825. On CIRS, STCNet achieved PSNR values up to 36.497 dB and SSIM values up to 0.877. These results support STCNet as a promising framework for low-dose, phase-resolved 4D CBCT reconstruction in image-guided radiotherapy.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Image-guided radiation therapy (IGRT) has become integral to contemporary radiotherapy by enabling treatment delivery to be aligned with patient anatomy at the time of irradiation Franzone et al. (2016) ; Cuijpers et al. (2017) ; Caillet et al. (2017) ; Johnson-Hart et al. (2018) . This role is especially critical for thoracic malignancies, where respiratory motion can introduce substantial uncertainty in tumor position during treatment and thereby compromise targeting accuracy Caillet et al. (2017) ; Johnson-Hart et al. (2018) ; Roman et al. (2012) ; Balik et al. (2013) . In this setting, robust on-board imaging is essential not only for setup verification, but also for motion-aware assessment of the tumor and surrounding normal tissues Franzone et al. (2016) ; Cuijpers et al. (2017) ; Caillet et al. (2017) ; Johnson-Hart et al. (2018) .
Cone-beam computed tomography (CBCT) is widely used for volumetric image guidance on the treatment unit. Franzone et al. (2016) ; Cuijpers et al. (2017) ; Caillet et al. (2017) ; Johnson-Hart et al. (2018) ; Roman et al. (2012) However, conventional three-dimensional CBCT has well-recognized limitations in the thorax because respiratory motion is averaged into a single reconstructed volume, often causing motion blur, streak artifacts, and loss of boundary definition Caillet et al. (2017) ; Balik et al. (2013) ; Ou et al. (2024) ; Qi and Chen (2011) . These degradations can reduce confidence in target localization and limit the reliability of image guidance for moving lesions Caillet et al. (2017) ; Johnson-Hart et al. (2018) ; Roman et al. (2012) ; Balik et al. (2013) .

blocks.en:
Four-dimensional CBCT (4D CBCT) was developed to overcome this limitation by sorting projection data into respiratory-correlated bins and reconstructing phase-resolved image volumes Ou et al. (2024) ; Zhi et al. (2021) . By preserving temporal information across the breathing cycle, 4D CBCT can improve visualization of moving targets and provide a more informative representation of respiratory motion than conventional CBCT Qi and Chen (2011) ; Brehm et al. (2013) ; Wang and Gu (2013) ; Jia et al. (2012) ; Zhang et al. (2017) . This capability is particularly relevant for radiotherapy workflows that depend on accurate motion characterization, including target verification, treatment adaptation, and motion management Caillet et al. (2017) ; Brehm et al. (2013) ; Zhang et al. (2017) .
Despite its clinical appeal, routine use of 4D CBCT remains constrained by image quality limitations. Because the acquired projections are divided across respiratory phases, each phase is reconstructed from only a small subset of views, making 4D CBCT inherently a sparse-view problem Ou et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2017) ; Mascolo-Fortin et al. (2018) . The resulting undersampling can produce severe streaking artifacts, structural distortion, and unstable intensity representation, particularly when the number of projections per phase is further reduced to limit imaging dose Brehm et al. (2013) ; Jia et al. (2012) ; Zhang et al. (2017) ; Mascolo-Fortin et al. (2018) . These limitations directly affect the clinical interpretability of phase-resolved images.
Dose efficiency is therefore a central challenge in 4D CBCT. In practice, obtaining acceptable image quality often requires many projections acquired over multiple breathing cycles, increasing scan time and imaging dose Yang et al. (2022) . This is undesirable in radiotherapy, where repeated on-board imaging may be needed throughout a treatment course Franzone et al. (2016) ; Caillet et al. (2017) ; Johnson-Hart et al. (2018) . Methods that enable high-quality reconstruction from substantially fewer projections could therefore improve the practicality of low-dose 4D CBCT for routine clinical guidance Chan et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) .
A broad range of strategies has been proposed to address sparse-view 4D CBCT reconstruction. Motion-compensated methods exploit inter-phase deformation to reduce respiratory artifacts and improve reconstruction fidelity Ou et al. (2024) ; Brehm et al. (2013) . Regularized iterative approaches, including temporal nonlocal and motion-compensated formulations, can further suppress noise and undersampling artifacts Wang and Gu (2013) ; Jia et al. (2012) ; Mascolo-Fortin et al. (2018) . However, these approaches often depend on accurate motion estimation, may be computationally intensive, and can oversmooth fine structures when the acquisition is extremely sparse.
Deep learning has recently emerged as a powerful alternative for sparse-view CT and CBCT reconstruction Zhang et al. (2024a) ; Dong et al. (2023) ; Li et al. (2019) ; Lee et al. (2019) ; Zhang et al. (2018) ; Cao et al. (2022) ; Xie et al. (2018) . Prior studies have explored image-domain artifact reduction Chan et al. (2023) ; Xie et al. (2018) ; Han and Ye (2018) , sinogram- or projection-domain synthesis Li et al. (2019) ; Lee et al. (2019) , ultra-sparse-view volumetric reconstruction Zhang et al. (2018) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) , and generative modeling frameworks based on diffusion or flow models Xia et al. (2022) ; Liu et al. (2022) . Deep learning has also been used to derive four-dimensional CBCT information from highly limited acquisition data, highlighting the potential of data-driven reconstruction for low-dose imaging Yang et al. (2022) . Nevertheless, many existing methods primarily address either data completion or image enhancement in isolation, without fully exploiting the coupled geometric structure of projection acquisition and the temporal continuity of respiratory motion that define the 4D CBCT problem Li et al. (2019) ; Heylen et al. (2019) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) .
For 4D CBCT, these two forms of prior information are fundamentally complementary. Projection measurements are governed by fixed acquisition geometry, whereas reconstructed anatomy evolves in a temporally correlated manner across respiratory phases Xie et al. (2018) ; Wang and Gu (2013) ; Jia et al. (2012) ; Zhang et al. (2017) . A reconstruction framework that jointly models both relationships may therefore recover missing information more faithfully than approaches operating in only a single domain or without explicit temporal consistency Yang et al. (2022) ; Zhang et al. (2024a) ; Zhang et al. (2024b) .
In this work, we propose STCNet, a sparse-view 4D CBCT reconstruction framework based on spatial-temporal consistency learning. STCNet is designed for low-dose phase-resolved imaging using only 16 projections per respiratory phase. The framework combines projection-domain completion with image-domain refinement after Feldkamp-Davis-Kress reconstruction. In the projection domain, physics-aware positional encoding is used to represent angular acquisition geometry, while temporal encoding is introduced to capture respiratory dynamics across phases. The completed projections are then reconstructed and further refined to improve structural fidelity and suppress residual sparse-view artifacts.

Sparse-view projections are sorted into P = 10 P=10 respiratory phases, with N = 16 N=16 projections per phase. The projection-domain generation module (PDGM) incorporates physics-aware positional encoding of acquisition angles and LSTM-based temporal consistency encoding to generate K = 256 K=256 dense-view projections per phase. FDK reconstruction converts the generated projections into initial phase-resolved volumes, which are subsequently refined by the image-domain correction module (IDCM) to produce the final 4D CBCT sequence.

blocks.en: CIRS Thorax Phantom Dataset To evaluate the reconstruction performance of STCNet under controlled experimental conditions, a dynamic CIRS thorax phantom was scanned using a CBCT imaging system in our laboratory. The phantom was scanned along a circular acquisition trajectory and contained a spherical target serving as a tumor surrogate. During acquisition, the target underwent prescribed sinusoidal motion to simulate respiratory-induced tumor displacement.

These phase-specific projection subsets were used for subsequent sparse-view reconstruction experiments.

blocks.zh: 蒂亚-隆 数据集 公开的TCIA-LUNG数据集Roman等(2012年);Balik等(2013年);Clark等(2013年);Hugo等(2016年)被用于评价STCNet超出被控制的幻想设定的通缩性能. 与CIRS奇幻实验相反,该数据集提供了病人解剖结构,用于评估拟议方法对更复杂的胸腔解剖学的适用性.

blocks.en: 2.2 Comparison Methods
blocks.zh: 2.2 比较方法

blocks.en: We compared STCNet with both conventional reconstruction methods and representative deep learning baselines. The conventional methods included FDK, simultaneous algebraic reconstruction technique (SART) Andersen and Kak (1984) , and SART-TV / OSCTV-based sparse-view reconstruction Mascolo-Fortin et al. (2018) . The deep learning baselines included N-Net, CyCN-Net Zhi et al. (2021) , and AttUNet Chan et al. (2023) . We also evaluated the projection-domain module alone (PDGM) to assess the contribution of dual-domain refinement.
blocks.zh: 我们把STCNet与传统的重建方法和具有代表性的深入学习基线进行比较。 常规方法包括FDK,同时代数重建技术(SART)Andersen和Kak (1984),以及基于OSCTV的稀有景地重建Mascolo-Fortin等 (2018). 深层学习基线包括N-Net、CyCN-Net Zhi等(2021)和AttUNet Chan等(2023)。 我们还仅评价了预测领域模块,以评估双重领域改进的贡献。

blocks.en: 2.3 Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: 2.3 评价计量

blocks.en: We evaluated reconstruction quality using mean absolute error (MAE) Chai et al. (2014) , peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) Poobathy and Chezian (2014) , and structural similarity index (SSIM) Chen and Bovik (2011) . MAE measures the absolute intensity difference between the reconstructed image and the reference image, with lower values indicating better reconstruction accuracy. PSNR quantifies fidelity in terms of signal-to-error ratio, with higher values indicating better image quality.SSIM measures structural similarity and perceptual consistency between images, with higher values indicating better structural preservation.
blocks.zh: 我们使用平均绝对错误(MAE)评价重建质量 Chai等人(2014年),峰值信号与噪音比率(PSNR) Poobathy和Chezian(2014年),结构相似性指数(SSIM) 陈和博维克(2011年). MAE测量被重建的图像与参考图像的绝对强度相差,而较低的数值表明重建的精度更高. PSNR在信号对误差比方面将忠诚度量化,更高的数值表明图像质量更好. SSIM测量图像之间的结构相似性和感知一致性,更高的值表明结构保存更好.

blocks.en: 2.4 Implement Details
blocks.zh: 2.4 实施细节

blocks.en: All experiments were implemented in Python using the PyTorch framework. Training and validation were conducted on a workstation equipped with an Intel CPU, 128 GB RAM, and an NVIDIA A6000 GPU with 48 GB memory.
blocks.zh: 所有实验都使用PyTorch框架在Python进行. 在配备了Intel CPU,128 GB RAM,以及拥有48 GB内存的NVIDIA A6000 GPU的工作站上进行了培训和验证.

blocks.en: For TCIA-LUNG, each phase volume was forward projected into 256-view dense projection data, and 16 uniformly sampled views were selected as sparse-view input. The PDGM and IDCM were trained as the two sequential components of the overall framework. During inference, the trained STCNet model took sparse-view phase-resolved projection data as input and generated the final reconstructed 4D CBCT volumes.
blocks.zh: 对于TCIA-LUNG来说,每个相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 作为总体框架的两个相继组成部分,已培训了PDGM和IDCM。 在推论期间,训练有素的STCNet模型取出稀有的相解投影数据作为输入并生成了最终重建的4D CBCT卷.

blocks.en: 2.5 Quantitative Comparison
blocks.zh: 2.5 数量比较

STCNet进一步将PSNR分别提高到了第2,5和8阶段的36.497,36.392和36.261分贝,对应的SSIM值为:0.871,0.874;0.877和MAE值为:0.018,0.017和0.018. 它的PSNR增益为5.760–5.984 dB比PDGM更能支持幻相实验中图像域修正的额外好处.

blocks.en: On the TCIA-LUNG dataset, SART and SART-TV improved all three metrics relative to FDK, while the deep-learning baselines showed mixed performance across metrics. PDGM ranked second at all evaluated phases, achieving PSNR values of 29.738–30.332 dB and SSIM values of 0.713–0.715. STCNet further increased PSNR to 33.311, 32.695, and 32.658 dB at phases 2, 5, and 8, respectively, with corresponding SSIM values of 0.845, 0.823, and 0.825 and MAE values of 0.035, 0.032, and 0.039. The PSNR gains of 2.920–2.979 dB over PDGM support the generalization performance of the dual-domain framework beyond the controlled phantom setting.
blocks.zh: 在TCIA-LUNG数据集上,SART和SART-TV相对于FDK改进了所有三个度量,而深层学习基线显示各度量的绩效参差不齐. PDGM在所有评价阶段排名第二,达到29.738–30.332 dB和SSIM值0.713–0.715. STCNet进一步将二、五和八相中的PSNR分别提高到33.311、32.695和32.658分贝,对应的SSIM值为:0.845、0.823、0.825和MAE值为:0.035、0.032和0.039。 PSNR比PDGM增益2.920–2.979 dB,支持了双域框架在被控制的幽灵设置之外的通化性能.

Figure 2 additionally compares PSNR and SSIM in the coronal and sagittal planes. The CIRS dataset was used for experimental validation, whereas the TCIA-LUNG dataset was used to assess generalization beyond the controlled phantom setting.
The coronal and sagittal comparisons in Fig. 2 show a similar trend: STCNet consistently achieved the highest PSNR and SSIM across the displayed phases on both datasets. Together with the axial-slice results, these findings demonstrate improved reconstruction fidelity and structural similarity across the evaluated anatomical planes and respiratory phases, supporting the complementary roles of projection-domain generation and image-domain correction.
blocks.zh:
图2还比较了日冕和平面飞机中的PSNR和SSIM. CIRS数据集用于实验验证,而TCIA-LUNG数据集则用于评估超出被控制的幻象设定的通称.
图2中的日冕和平面比较也显示出类似的趋势: STCNet在两个数据集显示的各个阶段都始终实现了最高的PSNR和SSIM. 这些结论与轴切片结果一起,表明在经过评估的解剖平面和呼吸阶段,重建忠心度和结构相似性得到提高,支持了投影-域生成和图像-域校正的补充作用。

blocks.en: 2.6 Reconstruction Quality
blocks.zh: 2.6 重建质量

blocks.en: We then tested the model on the CIRS thorax phantom dataset. Figure 3 shows the results.
blocks.zh: 然后我们在CIRS胸腔幽灵数据集测试了模型. 图3显示结果。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Reconstruction results on the CIRS phantom dataset: The figure shows coronal, sagittal, and axial slices at phases 2, 5, and 8 for different methods. The red and yellow dashed lines mark tumor marker boundary positions across phases.
blocks.zh: 图3:CIRS幽灵数据集的重建结果: 图中为不同方法显示第2,5相和8相的冠状,平相和轴切片. 红色和黄色的破折线标记了肿瘤标记的分相位置。

blocks.en: The FDK Feldkamp et al. (1984) again exhibited severe artifacts, particularly in the axial plane, which made tumor-marker boundaries difficult to identify. SART Andersen and Kak (1984) and SART-TV Mascolo-Fortin et al. (2018) reduced some of these errors but still left visible artifacts and incomplete boundaries. The deep-learning baselines did not perform consistently: some methods improved smoothness, but they often missed fine structural details or distorted the marker boundaries.
blocks.zh: FDK Feldkamp等人(1984年)再次展出严重的文物,特别是在轴平面上,这使得肿瘤标记器的界限难以识别。 SART Andersen和Kak(1984年)和SART-TV Mascolo-Fortin等人(2018年)减少了其中的一些出错,但仍留下了可见的文物和不完整的边界. 深入学习的基线没有连贯一致地发挥作用:有些方法提高了平滑度,但往往错过了精细的结构细节或扭曲了标记边界.

blocks.en: STCNet provided the clearest reconstructions on this dataset. Marker boundaries were more accurate, structures appeared more continuous, and residual artifacts were fewer. These results suggest that STCNet can generalize beyond the training-like data setting.
blocks.zh: STCNet在这一数据集上提供了最清晰的重建. 标记界限更准确,结构出现更连续,所剩文物较少. 这些结果表明,STCNet可以概括到类似培训的数据设置之外。

blocks.en: 2.7 Generalization Ability
blocks.zh: 2.7 通用能力

blocks.en: We first tested STCNet on the TCIA-LUNG dataset. Figure 4 shows coronal, sagittal, and axial results at phases 2, 5, and 8.
blocks.zh: 我们首先在TCIA-LUNG数据集上测试了STCNet. 图4显示第2、第5和第8阶段的日冕、平面和轴向结果。

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Reconstruction results on the TCIA-LUNG dataset: The figure shows coronal, sagittal, and axial slices at phases 2, 5, and 8 for different methods. The red and yellow dashed lines mark the highest and lowest diaphragm positions and show the motion path across phases.
blocks.zh: 图4:TCIA-LUNG数据集的重建结果: 图中为不同方法显示第2,5相和8相的冠状,平相和轴切片. 红色和黄色的破折线标出最高和最低的横跨相位并显示运动路径.

blocks.en:
The FDK Feldkamp et al. (1984) produced strong streak artifacts under the sparse-view setting. The ribs and spine looked blurred and broken. Soft tissue boundaries were also unclear. SART and SART-TV improved the overall appearance, but both methods still had visible noise and smoothing effects. SART Andersen and Kak (1984) kept more structure than FDK, but it introduced noisy textures. SART-TV Mascolo-Fortin et al. (2018) reduced some noise, but it also blurred fine details.
The deep learning baselines showed mixed results. N-Net and CycN-Net Zhi et al. (2021) reduced some artifacts, but they did not recover fine structures well. AttUNet Chan et al. (2023) produced smoother images, but it still caused anatomical distortion in some regions.
blocks.zh:
FDK Feldkamp等人(1984年)在零星的视野下生产出很强的花纹文物。 肋骨和脊椎看起来模糊而破碎。 软组织界限也不清楚。 SART和SART-TV改进了整体外观,但这两种方法仍然有明显的噪声和平滑效果. SART Andersen和Kak(1984年)保存了比FDK更多的结构,但它引入了吵闹的纹理. SART-TV Mascolo-Fortin等 (2018年)减少了一些噪音,但也模糊了细细的细节.
深入学习的基线显示结果好坏参半。 N-Net和CycN-Net Zhi等. (2021年)削减了部分文物,但并没有很好地恢复精细的结构. AttUNet Chan等人(2023年)制作了更平滑的图像,但它仍然在一些地区造成解剖扭曲.

blocks.en: STCNet provided the best overall visual quality among the tested methods. The reconstructions showed fewer streak artifacts. The diaphragm region was more clearly delineated. Bone and soft tissue boundaries were more natural. The overall anatomical structure was also closer to the ground truth. PDGM alone already improved the image quality a lot. The full STCNet improved it further after image-domain correction.
blocks.zh: STCNet为试验方法提供了最佳的整体视觉质量。 重建的文物较少 隔膜地区的划分更为明确。 骨和软组织边界比较自然. 总体解剖结构也更接近于地面真相. 光是PDGM就已经提高了图像质量 完整的STCNet在图像域修正后进一步改进了它.

blocks.en: 2.8 HU Error Map Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.8 HU 出错地图分析

blocks.en: Figure 5 : HU difference maps on the TCIA-LUNG dataset: The maps show axial, coronal, and sagittal differences between reconstructed images and ground truth. Red and blue represent positive and negative HU errors.
blocks.zh: 图5:TCIA-LUNG数据集HU相差图: 这些地图显示了重建后图像与地面真实性之间的轴心,冠心和相差. 红色和蓝色代表正负HU错误.

blocks.en:
We also compared HU difference maps on the TCIA-LUNG dataset (Figure 5 ). These maps show the difference between each reconstruction and the ground truth.
The FDK method showed large error regions across all planes. The largest errors appeared near dense structures and tissue boundaries. SART reduced part of the error, but it still showed scattered noise-like deviations. SART-TV reduced some noisy errors, but it also produced boundary loss in transition areas.
blocks.zh:
我们还在TCIA-LUNG数据集(图5)上比较了HU差异图. 这些地图显示了每次重建与地面真相的区别.
FDK方法在所有飞机上都显示出大出错区域. 最大的出错出现在密集的结构和组织边界附近. SART减少了部分出错,但仍显示出零散的噪声等偏差. SART-TV减少了一些噪音出错,但也造成了过渡地区的边界损失.

blocks.en:
N-Net and CycN-Net still showed clear deviations near the lung boundary and mediastinal regions. AttUNet reduced some errors, but noticeable distortion remained in difficult areas.
PDGM reduced HU errors by a large margin. This result shows that projection completion is important for sparse-view reconstruction. STCNet reduced the errors even more after adding image-domain correction. The remaining errors became smaller and more localized. This pattern was clear near the pulmonary hilum, airway regions, and soft tissue interfaces.
blocks.zh:
N-Net和CycN-Net在肺部边界和介质区域附近仍然显示出明显的偏差。 AttUNet减少了一些错误,但在困难地区仍然存在明显的扭曲。
PDGM将HU误差降低了很大幅度. 这一结果表明,完成预测对零星的重建很重要。 STCNet在添加了图像域校正后将错误减少得更多. 剩下的错误变得较小,地方化程度也更高. 这种模式在肺部外壳,气道区域以及软组织界面附近是明显的.

blocks.en: On the TCIA-LUNG dataset, the baseline model reached an MAE of 0.162, a PSNR of 23.916 dB, and an SSIM of 0.382. When we added PDGM, the model substantially improved. The MAE dropped to 0.059. The PSNR increased to 30.352 dB. The SSIM increased to 0.747. These changes show that projection-domain generation is a key part of the framework.
blocks.zh: 在TCIA-LUNG数据集上,基准模型达到MAE为0.162,PSNR为23.916分贝,SSIM为0.382. 当我们加入PDGM时,模型大大改进了. MAE降为0.059. PSNR增加到了30.352分贝. SSIM增加到了0.747. 这些变化表明,投影域生成是框架的关键部分.

blocks.en:
When we added IDCM alone, the model also improved. But the gain was smaller than the gain from PDGM. This result suggests that image-domain correction is useful, but it depends on a good initial reconstruction.
When we combined PDGM and IDCM, the model achieved the best results on both datasets. On TCIA-LUNG, STCNet reached an MAE of 0.036, a PSNR of 32.536 dB, and an SSIM of 0.824. On CIRS, STCNet reached an MAE of 0.018, a PSNR of 36.543 dB, and an SSIM of 0.878. Figure 6 shows that this advantage remained stable across phases. These findings support the idea that the two modules work well together.
blocks.zh:
当我们单独加入IDCM时,模型也得到了改进. 但收益比PDGM的收益还小. 这个结果表明图像域校正是有用的,但这取决于良好的初始重建.
将PDGM和IDCM合并后,该模型在两个数据集上都取得了最佳结果. 在TCIA-LUNG上,STCNet达到了0.036的MAE,PSNR为32.536分贝,SSIM为0.824. 在CIRS上,STCNet达到了0.018的MAE,36.543分贝的PSNR和0.878的SSIM. 图6显示,这一优势在各个阶段都保持稳定。 这些结论支持这两个单元合作良好的想法。

blocks.en: 3 Discussion
blocks.zh: 3 讨论情况

blocks.en: This study presents STCNet, a dual-domain framework for sparse-view 4D CBCT reconstruction. The method combines projection completion and image refinement. The method also models both spatial geometry and respiratory motion. The results show that STCNet improves image quality on both TCIA-LUNG and CIRS data.
blocks.zh: 本研究提出STCNet,为稀有视野4D CBCT重建的双域框架. 该方法结合了投影完成和图像完善. 该方法还同时模拟了空间几何和呼吸运动. 结果显示,STCNet提高了TCIA-LUNG和CIRS数据的图像质量.

blocks.en: The results support two main points. First, projection-domain recovery matters a lot in sparse-view 4D CBCT. PDGM alone already produced large gains over the baseline and other methods. This result suggests that early recovery of missing projection information is important. Second, image-domain correction adds further value after reconstruction. IDCM reduced residual artifacts and improved local structure. The best performance came from combining both modules.
blocks.zh: 结果支持两点。 首先,投影领域恢复在稀有的4D CBCT中很重要. 光是PDGM就已经在基线和其他方法上取得了巨大收益。 这一结果表明,早日恢复缺失的预测信息很重要。 第二,图像域校正在重建后进一步增加价值。 IDCM减少了残余文物并改进了当地结构. 最佳业绩来自两个单元的结合。

blocks.en: The spatial-temporal design also played an important role. Positional encoding helped the model learn the geometric relation between sparse angles. Temporal encoding helped the model use the continuity between breathing phases. These two parts likely explain why the method preserved phase-wise structure better than the comparison methods.
blocks.zh: 时空设计也发挥了重要作用. 位置编码帮助模型学习了稀有角度之间的几何关系. 时间编码帮助了模型在呼吸相间使用连续性. 这两个部分可能解释为什么这种方法比比较方法更好地保留了相向结构。

blocks.en: The study also has practical value. Sparse-view reconstruction can help reduce imaging dose and scan burden in 4D CBCT. STCNet used only 16 projections per phase and still produced strong results. This suggests that the method may support lower-dose imaging protocols in radiotherapy guidance. Improved phase-resolved image fidelity may also benefit downstream radiotherapy tasks, such as target localization, motion assessment, and adaptive decision-making, although these applications were not directly evaluated here.
blocks.zh: 这项研究也具有实际价值。 Sparse-view可帮助降低成像剂量并扫描4D CBCT中的重负. STCNet每个阶段只使用了16个预测,仍然产生很强的结果. 这表明该方法可能支持放射治疗指导中的低剂量成像协议. 改善相相解图像忠贞性也可能有利于下游放射治疗任务,如目标本地化,运动评估和适应性决策等,尽管这些应用在此没有直接评价.

blocks.en: Still, this work has several limitations. The first limitation is the sampling setting. We mainly trained and tested the model under a 16-view-per-phase design. The current results do not show how the model performs under more extreme sparse-view settings, such as 10 views or fewer. The second limitation is the lack of explicit anatomical priors. The method does not directly use structural knowledge about airways, vessels, or organ topology. This may reduce reconstruction reliability in cases with larger motion or more complex anatomy. The third limitation is the evaluation scope. We focused on image reconstruction metrics and visual quality. We did not test downstream tasks such as tumor localization, motion estimation, or dose calculation.
blocks.zh: 然而,这项工作仍然有一些局限性。 第一个限制是取样设置。 我们主要在16个视相设计下对模型进行培训和测试. 目前的结果没有显示模型在更极端的零星视图设置下是如何运行的,例如有10个或更少的视图. 第二个限制是缺乏明确的解剖学前科。 该方法不直接使用关于气道,船只,或器官地貌的结构知识. 这可能会在运动较大或更复杂的解剖学的情况下降低重建的可靠性. 第三个限制是评价范围。 我们侧重于图像重建指标和视觉质量。 我们没有测试下游的任务 比如肿瘤局部化 运动估计 或者剂量计算

blocks.en: Future work can address these points. One direction is to add anatomical priors from 4D CT or MRI. Another direction is to design adaptive view selection strategies for sparse acquisition. A third direction is to test the method in task-based radiotherapy settings. These steps would help clarify the clinical value of the framework.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作可以解决这些问题。 一个方向是从4D CT或核磁共振中添加解剖学前科. 另一个方向是设计适应性视图选择策略来进行稀有的获取. 第三个方向是在基于任务的放射治疗设置中测试方法. 这些步骤将有助于澄清框架的临床价值。

blocks.en: Temporal consistency encoding A key property of 4D CBCT is that anatomical structures evolve continuously across respiratory phases rather than changing independently from one phase to another.
